subject: [hw] DONE DEC06 rev 4: DEC08 rule 8 console channel (n2vt_say, weak) added; N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2521/2521
body:
DONE DEC06 rev 4. Supersedes rev 3. Host only: no phone, nothing published, no commit outside my owned files.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2521/2521

Changes since rev 3:
- DEC08 binding rule 8 (log with n2vt_say like n2avc): added n2vtd_log.{h,c}. One bounded line per event, forwarded to n2vt_say (gpu/video/vt/n2vt_log.c) as a WEAK import, so a link without that file is silent and still works; the host test defines a strong n2vt_say and asserts the lines. Events: "registered N hardware decoder(s) (avc1+hvc1)", "not registered: switch files ... say off", "avc1/hvc1 decoder not offered: daemon unavailable...", "session start <codec> WxH stride buf_h MM21|NV12 video-range|full-range", "session start failed in configure (n)", "session rejected: parameter sets unreadable", "first picture pts=... WxH", "DEC_INPUT failed (n), frame dropped". That gives the main session a console trail on the first phone boot: the plug-in load/registration line, the session geometry, and the first frame.
- The iOS link audit now allows one more weak import (_n2vt_say); 65 undefined, all covered (60 TBD, 5 weak/linker). Build list is now 7 plug-in objects + mm21/n2_mm21.c, and optionally gpu/video/vt/n2vt_log.c for console output (see vt/dec/STATUS.md §Integration).
- T_OBJ is 162 checks per build (adds the four console-line assertions), suite total 2521.

Not done (unchanged): no phone run / no daemon end-to-end; MM21 order libyuv-verified but not phone-verified; crop origin always 0; 10-bit/non-4:2:0/interlaced refused per frame without a nested software-session fallback; in-band parameter-set changes not tracked; CPU-side copy; setProperties/copySerializableProperties reply -12782; emit under the session mutex.

Files since rev 3: vt/dec/n2vtd_log.{h,c} (new), vt/dec/n2vtd_obj.c, vt/dec/n2vtd_register.c, vt/dec/test/t_apple_dec.{h,c} (strong n2vt_say capture), vt/dec/test/t_obj.c, vt/dec/run_tests.sh, vt/dec/symbols.txt, vt/dec/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md. All inside my owned directories.
